Convention and Expo tips

Dress for warm weather. Even though that a lot of the places that I have been do not have heating, the body heat will make the place warm.

Take water. With all the walking around, you will get thirsty.

Take a snack, with moving around, you will get a little hungry.

Take something to hold your purchases. A backpack would be fine, I have used a stroller, I had a baby with me.

Keep your stuff safe. Even though the vast majority of the people out there are honest, there are still a few that are not.

Keep within your budget. The easiest way to do so is to bring cash only. There is a lot of venders that will only take cash only. There are a few that will process cards. Keep in mind that the ones that process cards are the exception and not the rule.

Know what you are buying. If you don't know much about what you are buying, don't be afraid to ask. A lot of people there will know something about what you are looking at.
